qs.s: Le ___ de l'immeuble vérifie l'état des parties communes chaque semaine.

qs.en: This chess player is a formidable opponent whom no one has managed to beat.

qs.en: The detectives on this team are formidable: they solve the most complex cases.

qs.s: Cette adversaire de tennis est ___ grâce à son service et sa précision.
qs.en: This tennis opponent is formidable thanks to her serve and precision.

qs.en: The government has set up integration programs for immigrant workers.

qs.en: This immigrant left his home country to find better opportunities.

qs.en: Immigrant children often adapt more quickly than their parents.

qs.en: These immigrant workers contribute significantly to the national economy.

qs.s: Cette femme ___ a ouvert un restaurant dans le quartier.
qs.en: This immigrant woman opened a restaurant in the neighbourhood.

qs.s: La communauté ___ de la ville organise chaque année une fête culturelle.

qs.s: Ces femmes ___ ont fondé une association pour s'entraider.
qs.en: These immigrant women founded an association to help one another.

qs.s: Les familles ___ ont souvent du mal à trouver un logement abordable.
qs.en: Immigrant families often struggle to find affordable housing.
